name: Francesco Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Italian Wikipedia gives his birth as 23 July 1914 at Conflenti (S1). He was a magistrate and was shot dead on 3 July 1975 near his home in Nicastro (Lamezia Terme). He was the paternal uncle of Corrado Ferlaino, the SSC Napoli owner (living; not researched). No genealogical link to John's San Mango Ferlainos was found.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Notable is real; kinship to John unproven.
